postcards.subject: Idyll & Imaginings
postcards.message:
Hey!
I hope you're having fun in London. I hope the trip is the refreshing break I know you've needed for a while. I wonder about all the things you're seeing and trying.
Say hello to the Queen if you see her!
postcards.postscript: What was the first thing you noticed about London?

postcards.subject: Gold, Glum
postcards.message:
Hello!
I had pancakes at Glen's for breakfast today. They were not very good. Would not recommend. Bad maple syrup and clumpy pancakes. Wondering if you've had some good British food yet. I want to ask you so many things, but I'm putting them here for now...
Have a good day, I know you'll do well.
postcards.postscript: How do you like British food?

postcards.subject: Rainy Rumination
postcards.message:
Hello!
It's raining here and Hilbert is settling in for a nap as I write this. I hope Haju is doing okay too. I wonder if it's been raining in London as well. Time-zones make things confusing. I know things must be hectic, but I hope you're having fun nevertheless.
Strange, to miss you more now, while you're in London, when our cadence of communication hasn't changed much, but I do.
postcards.postscript: How's the jet-lag been treating you?

postcards.subject: Sofie's Sharaarat
postcards.message:
Hey,
Sofie and Hilbert are slowly warming up to each other, as you can see.
I'm keeping myself busy. Spent today cooking (made a salami sandwich), studying (still in that physics textbook), thinking (hoping you have a bright day), painting (a few projects). Sending warmth.
postcards.postscript: If you had to give a talk at the LDF next year, what would it be about?

postcards.subject: Skies and Syllabi
postcards.message:
Hello,
The sunset today was quite beautiful. I'm guessing this may be the first card you see, as I sent you the link today. I've started reading Stone Mattress and rearranged my books, been working on a paper you might find interesting. Been attending the IEEE Quantum Week conference this week, and gotta take Hilbert to the vet today too.
Hope you're having a good week.
postcards.postscript: What is your favourite story from Stone Mattress?

postcards.subject: Salt & Screens
postcards.message:
Evening,
It never seems to go away, this imposter syndrome. Stretched thin, yet not doing enough. Sitting in on talks and meetings of people with more years, experience, degrees and citations than I.
I wonder if you feel something similar around all the artists, designers and leaders in London, from all over the world. I doubt you leave anyone less than dazzled, but do you ever find it as strange to suddenly be yourself?
postcards.postscript: Miss debriefing these things, and you.

postcards.subject: Whiskers & Whispers
postcards.message:
Evening,
Hilbert fell asleep again. In other news, my paper got accepted for December, and you know it never would've happened without you.
I'm not pushing against your decision, but these will still be here and so will I, for you.
Whatever this looks like from your end, it isn't too much effort, and it doesn't ask anything of you. If it brightens your day even a little, that's all I needed it to do. Hope you have a good one.
postcards.postscript: Hilbert says hi.

postcards.subject: Headaches & Hazy
postcards.message:
Hey,
If today's around when your time of the month might be, take it easy on yourself today. Hot chocolate might help, if you're in the mood for it. You know what you need better than I do. Save whatever energy you've got for yourself.
I'd rather be patient than ask anything of you.
Hope the jet-lag isn't making it worse on top of everything.
postcards.postscript: Google "Tilcayo" for something cute.

postcards.subject: Ruminating Reads
postcards.message:
I'm sorry.
I'm sorry that I made you feel overwhelmed. I've thought about that more than is wise, but I want to get this right. For you, not for me.
Not to make your life harder, or pull us back to what we were. I want you to know that, without needing anything in return.
Maybe you're right that there's more people, places and pursuits out there, but the voice I miss is yours. I just want us to feel easy again, whenever you're ready. Until then, I'll wait, and you're always welcome here.
postcards.postscript: You'd have liked my framework for these.

postcards.subject: Rain & Patience
postcards.message:
Hey,
Been raining all evening. Unable to get out of bed today.
I take a while to understand things, and I make my share of mistakes. Not asking you to fix any of it, just wanted you to know.
You tell me to grow my circle, that there's so much out there. Maybe so, but there's plenty in you too, and I want to know you, thorns and all.
Still patient, still here.
postcards.postscript: Hope your day's easier than mine.

postcards.subject: Quantemplations
postcards.message:
Hey,
Not a great day at work. Slept past my 4AM meeting, and woke up with clogged sinuses and to clogged roads. Might just throw in the towel for today. Tomorrow is tomorrow is tomorrow.
Also spent the last few days trying to find blood for a friend's friend's cat. I wish I could say it ended well, but it didn't.
To end on a lighter note, you should watch Coyote vs Acme, it's quite unique.
postcards.postscript: How's the drawing competition going on this trip? Are you winning?

postcards.subject: Mentoring Musings
postcards.message:
Hey,
Spent the day reviewing intern projects with another staff and a PhD student. One reminded me of the interesting interface of the ISC website. They're building something similar, but for battleship.
Hope you're still enjoying London. Wonder if you could see yourself working there. I doubt you'd overstay your welcome if you did.
postcards.postscript: The little envelopes flying around the page now follow an interesting algorithm.

postcards.subject: Wistful Winds
postcards.message:
Hi,
Spent today at the office. Busy, though hard to get excited about work these days.
There was a nice breeze blowing around the campus when I left. I hope it comes back when you're here, you'd have liked it. Hope the end of your trip leaves you refreshed and eager for whatever's next, I know you'll do great at it. I'm sure Haju will be glad you'll be back soon.
postcards.postscript: What have you missed most from Bangalore?

postcards.subject: Moody & Muted
postcards.message:
Hi,
The weather's been quiet, moody. The rain's been too light for a downpour, too heavy for a drizzle. You can only just hear the rain, if you listen for it.
Yesterday's breeze is still moving around. I hope it's still there when you're back.
postcards.postscript: What do you think you'll miss most about London?

postcards.subject: Miles & Mondays
postcards.message:
Hi,
I'm not sure if you're departing London or arriving in Bangalore today. I hope you had (or will have, or are having) a safe flight, and the flight brought (or brings or is bringing) some rest, reading, or relaxation.
I hope you get enough time to breathe and re-align your internal clock and self before the daily battles of work begin on Monday, and that the rest of your weekend goes well.
Also, if you get some downtime, I think you'd like the movie Resident Evil.
postcards.postscript: Hilbert sends purrs, mid-nap.

postcards.subject: Papers & Patience
postcards.message:
Hi,
Feeling quite unwell today, this is just the room I wake up in these days. Trying to write a paper with the working group about the language we use to compare quantum algorithms. Interesting work.
I hope you had a good weekend, and that getting back to work isn't too overwhelming. Hope your week starts, ends, and everything-in-betweens well.
postcards.postscript: Has your PR made any progress since you left?

postcards.subject: Wasps & Worries
postcards.message:
Hey,
Wasp on the in side of my window, bee on the out. Can't decide which is worse, but the bee doesn't have to sit with LLM-dependent puppets. I wonder how your "first" day back at work went. I know you'd have sat in on a few meetings from London already, but it can still feel as overwhelming as the thundering monsoon pouring onto our heads.
I hope you're letting yourself acclimate gently, and that the trip helped with the burnout. Hope you're having a good day.
postcards.postscript: The wasp disappeared (Scarier).

postcards.subject: Sniffles & Scratchboards
postcards.message:
Hey,
Took the day off, the whole team and possibly the town is down with the flu, myself included, so we're all toiling away online. My throat feels like Hilbert's scratchboard, and my head like his punching bag. The boy himself has been going the extra mile (meow-le?), demanding food and attention to no end.
Got a bunch of nice papers in the works, one's almost philosophical, might be interesting. I wonder how Homepage's going. Hope you haven't fallen sick too.
postcards.postscript: Hope you're keeping warm.

postcards.subject: Rain & Ruckus
postcards.message:
Hey,
Today was exhausting. Rained a lot, hope you didn't get stuck in it too. Heard a gas cylinder blew up near Bellandur, nobody was hurt thankfully, but I hope you're okay. Got stuck on the way home myself.
I wonder how your week's going. There was a play at BIC today I think you'd have liked, I wonder if you went.
I'm tired, hope you rest well tonight.
postcards.postscript: Back to Feynman, or still on Stone Mattress? No worries if it's neither so far.

postcards.subject: Clusters & Complaints
postcards.message:
Hey,
My idiot colleagues who offload their thinking to LLMs broke things again, and now want to blame the 'puter. End of rant.
I wonder how your day was. I hope it wasn't as frustrating as mine. I wonder if you've caught up on the salsa classes you missed to the flu and when you flew to London. I hope your first week back wasn't too much. I wonder what plans you have for the long weekend. I hope it's not work. I wonder what you've been listening to.
postcards.postscript: Have you seen season 2 of Deli Boys yet?

postcards.subject: Uncertain & Unwise
postcards.message:
Hey,
Annoyed by people who shortcut for themselves. People at IBM, ORNL, Munich know my name now, not sure how to feel about it. People in London know you as well. I wonder how many people in London still know and think about you. I think of the places you walked, the restaurants and cafes you sat in. I imagine little lights across the globe of people who know you, people who know me, if the two groups ever pass, or know each other without knowing you and I are in common.
postcards.postscript: Hilbert has weird postures sometimes.

postcards.subject: Sleepy & Spent
postcards.message:
Hey,
Tired, frustrated, overworked, sleepy.
Hope you're having a good weekend.
I want to say more, but it's just more asking how you are, more hoping that you're okay. I don't have the wherewithal to decorate that embarrassingly simple sentiment today.
postcards.postscript: Hilbert has a cold. Hope Haju is okay.

postcards.subject: Suffocating & Sniffling
postcards.message:
Hey,
Most days are exhausting, today's no exception. Hope you had a refreshing weekend. The weather's suffocating, but hope it gave you some breathing room after what I'm guessing was a hectic first week back. Hilbert has a dust allergy, he's sniffling.
postcards.postscript: Hope you have a good week ahead.

postcards.subject: Passports & Pressure
postcards.message:
Hey,
Exhausting day: a rapidly approaching paper deadline, a passport appointment, and a project kickoff event this week, all at once.
Hope your Monday was less hectic than mine. I wonder if you've tried the matcha yet.
postcards.postscript: Have you been writing anything about the London trip?

postcards.subject: Launches
postcards.message:
Hey,
Tomorrow's the launch of my project. I hope you see it. I can never thank you enough, but I hope to try.
I wonder if you've been playing any new puzzle games lately. I hope the rainy weather hasn't made you sick too. I hope you're keeping warm and cozy.
postcards.postscript: Hilbert was starting to stink, so I took him for his first bath.

postcards.subject: Melodies & Milestones
postcards.message:
Hey,
The meeting went well. I think this project is going to be something.
I wonder how your work's going. I joined music classes again. I want to tell you more about the project and work, and hear about yours.
postcards.postscript: Hope work isn't too hectic.

postcards.subject: Drafts & Deadlines
postcards.message:
Hey,
Been writing papers all day. A couple of big ones in the works, and then the next one. I hope this one goes well. Hilbert's been assisting, he caught a few mathematical errors I made.
Sofia had her first cup of tea today. Apparently she's addicted now.
I hope your week was good.
postcards.postscript: Been crocheting anything interesting lately?

postcards.subject: Hectic & Hushed
postcards.message:
Hey,
Submitted two papers today, one big one small. Always comes down to the wire on submission day, even after extensions. Two more after this, maybe three.
Things are so hectic here, and I find myself wondering how they are for you. What's kept you busiest this week? Learned anything cool? What have you been cooking?
I hope you have a fun weekend ahead, unless you're resting too? I think I'll sleep through mine, I'm so tired. I miss hearing from you.
postcards.postscript: Rest well this weekend, you've earned it.

postcards.subject: Azure Afternoon
postcards.message:
Hey,
I went to attend the protest but got sidetracked by the detentions, some whom I knew. I turned around and went to a fest, then to a book store. There was a cute dog there. I wonder how your weekend's going. Did you get some reading done? Artwork? Meeting friends? I'm home now, working on a paper. I can't help but always write them with you in mind. It's just the way my hands always end up moving, whether it's pen over paper or keys beneath a screen.
postcards.postscript: Please take care and stay safe.

postcards.subject: Shots & Scoops
postcards.message:
Hey,
Today's going slow. Hilbert had his last vaccine today, he was quite annoyed by the whole ordeal. Also saw my grandmother at the hospital today.
I hope you're keeping cool in this dry, sunny, dusty weather we've been having lately. Maybe you could try some of the new flavours at Ulo if you're in the mood for ice cream, I think you might like "A Shot In The Dark". Have you seen the new Spider-Man movie? I think you might enjoy it.
postcards.postscript: Primetime looks interesting too.

postcards.subject: Sorries & Silence
postcards.message:
Hey,
I'm sorry for texting you yesterday, I'm sorry that I'm so stupid, I just missed hearing from you and wanted to share about the papers I've been working on. I wanted to open a conversation. I don't know if you want that, but I'll wait and try my best to respect the distance until you want that.
I hope you have a good week ahead. I wonder what you did over the weekend.
postcards.postscript: Grandmother seems okay.

postcards.subject: Puzzles & Parenting
postcards.message:
Hey,
I'm wondering how your week is going so far. I miss playing Scrabble and Stardew and Overcooked and puzzles, I wonder if you've been playing on your own or with Neha or friends.
I want to know how your days are, what you've been up to. Hope your health is okay. Rubina and her mother have been clashing over parenting styles, in which I've unfortunately become a mediator.
postcards.postscript: How have your colleagues been? Has anything since London changed the way you work or see things?

postcards.subject: Blue & Bothered
postcards.message:
Hey,
The week feels slow, I wonder if it's similar for you. The weather's chilly and autumnal, with crunchy leaves around, I hope you've come across a few. Can you smell the flowers in the wind? What notes do you identify in their fragrance? Sometimes I wonder about the little things, what did you have for lunch today? Is it an office day or a stay-home-and-annoy-Haju day? You should try Block Two Coffee in Jayanagar, I think you'd like it, their matcha sounds interesting.
postcards.postscript: What are your plans for the rest of the week?

postcards.subject: Canopy Commotion
postcards.message:
Hey,
It's been pouring all evening, I hope it hasn't dampened your day. I hope you're enjoying the respite it's bringing from the dry spell we'd been enduring lately.
I wonder if you're attending or following the events at Figma Config today, I imagine all the presentations must be giving you stuff to think about. I wonder if you've been writing anything lately, I would love to see something like the design retrospective you wrote back in May.
postcards.postscript: I hope work is going okay.

postcards.subject: Rainy Refuge
postcards.message:
Hey,
I hope you're keeping warm in this rainy weather. It's oddly cozy, and I hope you're finding it cozy too. Hilbert is snuggling, I hope Haju is doing the same with you.
postcards.postscript: I hope you have a good weekend.

postcards.subject: Teething Troubles
postcards.message:
Hey,
Hilbert has been teething, and very confused by the fact that his teeth break when he tries to attack me. I wish I could explain it to him.
Tomorrow is my mother's birthday, I'm tired, but we have plans. How was your Saturday? I hope you didn't have work like I did.
postcards.postscript: I hope you're sleeping well.

postcards.subject: Pages & Presents
postcards.message:
Hey,
Mom's birthday has always been a bit of a delicate affair, since Grandad died on the same day in the pandemic. We try our best to get her mind off of that. We took her out for brunch with Rubina, Sofie and Salman, making ramen and sushi for dinner now.
I'm aware you might be feeling crampy today or soon, I hope it's not too bad. I hope it doesn't prevent you from being able to enjoy the festivities with your friends.
postcards.postscript: I wonder if you'd prefer hot chocolate, or a cold Milo shake. I hope you're having a good long weekend.

postcards.subject: Proxy Pandemonium
postcards.message:
Hey,
I've been dealing with some of the ugliest code I've seen, thanks to an overzealous meat proxy.
I hope you're feeling better today. I wonder if you've got more holidays, or if it's just today.
postcards.postscript: I hope you're having a good break from work, and that the burnout is getting better.

postcards.subject: Soaring Scout
postcards.message:
Hey,
I hope you're feeling better today. Hilbert has finished teething and is always finding a new place to climb to in the house. I wonder how work is going. I've got a nearly 1000 commit PR lined up over the week.
I've not had the best day myself, been in therapy and mostly in bed. I hope yours has been better.
postcards.postscript: I wonder if you're reading these.

postcards.subject: Evening Ease
postcards.message:
Hey,
I went to the doctor and got a haircut today. I forgot just how messy my hair gets.
I wonder how your day has been, and if you've been getting enough exercise. I hope you're getting enough steps instead of being hunched over a desk all day, like I have been. I hope the walks have been outside, accompanied by the smell of a promised downpour, and that the breeze cools the stress building in your head.
postcards.postscript: I wonder if you've seen any good shows lately.

postcards.subject: Paws & Pull Requests
postcards.message:
I found this website and thought you might like it: www.are.na
I hope your first PR has been merged successfully. Here's a picture of Hilbert. I hope you're doing okay. I just thought of you.

postcards.subject: Silent Sleep
postcards.message:
I heard they're sunsetting Arc and was sorry to hear it. Have you tried the other browser they made? I wonder what you think of it.
Have you heard about the PHP bug and eMudhra fiasco? There's so much happening in tech right now, hard to keep up.
I spent an all-nighter refactoring horrific code, resulting in a nearly 1000-commit PR. The smelliest code I've ever seen.
I hope you had a nice week and have a good weekend ahead. I'm sure you've got fun plans.
postcards.postscript: Hilbert is snoring.

postcards.subject: Phantom Pause
postcards.message: I wasted my time today going to a meeting that didn't end up happening. Yesterday was our second presentation to the international group and I had to do it and I think it went well. I wonder how your weekend is going. I want to hear from you, I want to reach out. I just don't know how.
postcards.postscript: Did you know that today is the last Pythagorean date of the century (10-24-26).

postcards.subject: Steadying Stance
postcards.message: Today a potential suitor for Saba came to meet her, and I went there as well so she would have someone in her corner. It's a tenuous situation, but far from as untenable as some would make it seem like it is. I wonder what this year's gift from your workplace was for Diwali, and how the terranium from last year is doing. Good night. I hope you have a good week ahead.

postcards.subject: Work's Wonder
postcards.message: It's going to be a tough week at work. I hope yours had a better start than mine did. Been ordering books but not really finishing any, hope you've had better luck (if you can call it luck) there. What are your plans for this week?
postcards.postscript: Have you been stitching anything lately?

postcards.subject: Bountiful Bloom
postcards.message: The amount of work is not letting up this week. The campus is quite beautiful these days as most of the flowers bloom. I hope some of the floral notes make their way to you. Have you been going on walks? I wonder how you are.
postcards.postscript: I hope you know that in mere there is someone always hoping you have a good day.

postcards.subject: Coding Calamities
postcards.message: Sometimes I wish I wasn't so elitist about coding agents, but the majority of generated code I see is just so smelly that I can't help but feel safe from a layoff. I wonder how your quarterly review went and if you're satisfied with your direction. I hope you're lined up for a promotion because you do more than a product designer should. My day was pretty unproductive. I hope that yours was better and that even if it wasn't, that you're giving yourself more grace for it.
postcards.postscript: I hope you're sleeping well. Good night.
